notes: # EEPROM Studio 1.0.6 — CH341A USB detection recovery (experimental beta) This signed update addresses CH341A USB reconnection and detection errors seen in version 1.0.5. It preserves the existing XP400 drivers and the CH341A SPI/I2C memory reader. - Scans the Android USB device list again after launch and while the app is in the foreground. - Repo
